text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“—Happy birthday, Your Majesty. From all 
of us, your retainers, we offer our 
heartfelt congratulations.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's dancing or a concert, please 
feel free to ask us for anything you wish♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Attendants? Desires...? What are you two 
even talking about? Please stop.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If you are asking for my wish, I would 
like you to treat me as you always do—"as 
a friend."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—...Fufu, hehehe♪ I knew it, that's so 
like you, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, that was just meant as a little bit 
of fun. It was Ruler-san's idea."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Still, you are who you are after all. 
Earnest, sincere—heh, classic you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I apologize if I dampened 
the mood. However, those are my true, 
unvarnished feelings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A king is a flower that blooms alone at 
the summit. Few can stand side by side to 
converse with one.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I want a friend to remain a 
friend. Always, and at all times.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's keep things as usual. 
Naturally, that means no handicaps in 
games either, but that's fine with you, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Of course. No special consideration is 
necessary. —You all are best just the way 
you are.
